nvimgcodecColorSpec_t.doc:
Defines color specification.

This enumeration specifies how the color information in image samples should be interpreted.

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_UNKNOWN.doc: The color specification is unknown or not specified.

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_UNCHANGED.doc: The color specification should be left unchanged; equivalent to UNKNOWN.

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_SRGB.doc: The image uses the standard RGB (sRGB) color space.

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_GRAY.doc: The image is grayscale (single channel, no color).

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_SYCC.doc: The image uses the sYCC color space (YCbCr with sRGB primaries).

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_CMYK.doc: The image uses the CMYK color space (Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Black).

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_YCCK.doc: The image uses the YCCK color space (YCbCr plus Black channel).

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_PALETTE.doc: Sample data is represented using a palette color map.

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_ICC_PROFILE.doc: Precise color space is provided in an ICC profile.

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_UNSUPPORTED.doc: The color specification is unsupported by the library.

NVIMGCODEC_COLORSPEC_ENUM_FORCE_INT.doc: Forces the enum to be represented as a 32-bit integer.

nvimgcodecImageBufferKind_t.doc: Defines buffer kind in which image data is stored.

NVIMGCODEC_IMAGE_BUFFER_KIND_STRIDED_DEV.doc: GPU-accessible with planes in pitch-linear layout.

NVIMGCODEC_IMAGE_BUFFER_KIND_STRIDED_HOS.doc: Host-accessible with planes in pitch-linear layout.

nvimgcodecJpegEncoding_t.doc:
JPEG Encoding.

Currently parseable JPEG encodings (SOF markers) <https://www.w3.org/Graphics/JPEG/itu-t81.pdf> Table B.1 Start of Frame markers.

nvimgcodecQualityType_t.doc: Supported quality types (algorithms), which determines how `quality_value` is interpreted.

NVIMGCODEC_QUALITY_TYPE_DEFAULT.doc: Each plugin decides what is best quality setting to use. `quality_value `is ignored.

NVIMGCODEC_QUALITY_TYPE_LOSSLESS.doc:
Image encoding is reversible and keeps original image quality. `quality_value` is ignored except for:

* the CUDA TIFF encoder backend, for which `quality_value = 0` means no compression, and `quality_value = 1` means LZW compression,
* the CPU PNG encoder backend, for which `quality_value` can be in range from 0 (lowest compression ratio, fastest) to 9 (highest compression ratio, slowest).

NVIMGCODEC_QUALITY_TYPE_QUALITY.doc: `quality_value` is interpreted as JPEG-like quality in range from 1 (worst) to 100 (best).

NVIMGCODEC_QUALITY_TYPE_QUANTIZATION_STE.doc: `quality_value` is interpreted as quantization step (by how much pixel data will be divided). The higher the value, the worse quality image is produced.

NVIMGCODEC_QUALITY_TYPE_PSNR.doc: `quality_value` is interpreted as desired Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) target for the encoded image. The higher the value, the better quality image is produced. Value should be positive.

NVIMGCODEC_QUALITY_TYPE_SIZE_RATIO.doc: `quality_value` is interpreted as desired encoded image size ratio compared to original size, should be floating in range (0.0, 1.0). E.g. value 0.1 means target size of 10% of original image.

NVIMGCODEC_BACKEND_KIND_CPU_ONLY.doc: Decoding/encoding is executed only on CPU.

NVIMGCODEC_BACKEND_KIND_GPU_ONLY.doc: Decoding/encoding is executed only on GPU.

NVIMGCODEC_BACKEND_KIND_HYBRID_CPU_GPU.doc: Decoding/encoding is executed on both CPU and GPU.

NVIMGCODEC_BACKEND_KIND_HW_GPU_ONLY.doc: Decoding/encoding is executed on GPU dedicated hardware engine.

nvimgcodecLoadHintPolicy_t.doc: Defines how to interpret the load hint parameter.

NVIMGCODEC_LOAD_HINT_POLICY_IGNORE.doc: Load hint is not taken into account.

NVIMGCODEC_LOAD_HINT_POLICY_FIXED.doc: Load hint is used to calculate the backend batch size once.

NVIMGCODEC_LOAD_HINT_POLICY_ADAPTIVE_MIN.doc: Load hint is used as an initial hint, and it is recalculated on every iteration to reduce the idle time of threads.

Decoder/encoder could potentially process image but is saturated.

See also

[nvimgcodecBackendParams_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvimagecodec/c_api.html#structnvimgcodecBackendParams__t) load_hint.

NVIMGCODEC_PROCESSING_STATUS_CODEC_UNSUP.doc: Processing failed because codec is unsupported.

NVIMGCODEC_PROCESSING_STATUS_BACKEND_UNS.doc: Processing failed because no one from allowed backends is supported.

NVIMGCODEC_PROCESSING_STATUS_ENCODING_UN.doc: Processing failed because codec encoding is unsupported.

NVIMGCODEC_PROCESSING_STATUS_RESOLUTION_.doc: Processing failed because image resolution is unsupported.

NVIMGCODEC_PROCESSING_STATUS_CODESTREAM_.doc: Processing failed because some feature of compressed stream is unsupported.

NVIMGCODEC_PROCESSING_STATUS_ORIENTATION.doc: Apply orientation was enabled but it is unsupported.

NVIMGCODEC_PROCESSING_STATUS_ROI_UNSUPPO.doc: Decoding region of interest is unsupported.

NVIMGCODEC_PROCESSING_STATUS_NUM_PLANES_.doc: Unsupported number of planes to decode/encode.

NVIMGCODEC_PROCESSING_STATUS_NUM_CHANNEL.doc: Unsupported number of channels to decode/encode.

NVIMGCODEC_JPEG2K_STREAM_J2K.doc: Corresponds to the JPEG2000 code stream.

nvimgcodecMetadataFormat_t.doc: Specifies the format of metadata contained in an image.

NVIMGCODEC_METADATA_VALUE_TYPE_UNDEFINED.doc: 8-bit byte, value depends on field definition.

NVIMGCODEC_METADATA_VALUE_TYPE_IFD.doc: 4-byte (32-bit) unsigned integer used for IFD offsets.

NVIMGCODEC_METADATA_VALUE_TYPE_IFD8.doc: 8-byte (64-bit) unsigned integer used for IFD offsets (BigTIFF).

NVIMGCODEC_DEBUG_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_WARNIN.doc: Message about behavior that is not necessarily an error, but very likely a bug in your application.

NVIMGCODEC_DEBUG_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR.doc: Message about behavior that is invalid and may cause improper execution or result of operation (e.g. can’t open file) but not application.

NVIMGCODEC_DEBUG_MESSAGE_CATEGORY_GENERA.doc: Some event has happened that is unrelated to the specification or performance.

NVIMGCODEC_DEBUG_MESSAGE_CATEGORY_VALIDA.doc: Something has happened that indicates a possible mistake.

NVIMGCODEC_DEBUG_MESSAGE_CATEGORY_ALL.doc: Used in case filtering out by message category.

nvimgcodecPriority_t.doc:
Defines decoder or encoder priority in codec.

For each codec there can be more decoders and encoders registered. Every decoder and encoder is registered with defined priority. Decoding process starts with selecting highest priority decoder and checks whether it can decode particular code stream. In case decoding could not be handled by selected decoder, there is fallback mechanism which selects next in priority decoder. There can be more decoders registered with the same priority. In such case decoders with the same priority are selected in order of registration.
